table_name: Table 7 - Minimum Requirements for Fire Fighting Installations
structural_difference_from_2026: CONFIRMED: 2016 has a SINGLE unified Table 7 covering ALL occupancy groups A through J in one continuous table (11 landscape pages in the source), NOT split into per-occupancy Table 7A-7J like 2026. 2026's Foreword itself confirms this: 'The table on minimum requirements for firefighting installations (erstwhile Table 23 and now Table 7) has been comprehensively updated' - meaning 2016's Table 7 was ITSELF already a renumbering of an even earlier Table 23, and 2026 then split this single table into 10 occupancy-specific tables (7A-7J).
extraction_method_and_confidence_warning: IMPORTANT: unlike every other table in this dataset, Table 7 is NOT present as editable text anywhere in the source .docx - it is embedded as 11 full-page RASTER IMAGES (landscape, ~2736x1790px PNGs). No native table structure survives. This dataset's Table 7 content was recovered by running Tesseract OCR against each of the 11 page images (upscaled 2x first) and manually reading the OCR output back into structured JSON. OCR of a dense 14-column technical table with many merged cells is inherently error-prone: numbers can be misread (e.g. '25 000' vs '75 000'), cells can be dropped or shifted a row, and R/NR marks are sometimes missing from the OCR output entirely where the source cell was genuinely blank (meaning 'not applicable/not specified for that column at that band' rather than a definite NR). EVERY row in every table7_*.json file in this folder should be treated as 'extraction_confidence: needs_verification' and checked against the original PDF/document before being used to drive an actual compliance decision. Where the OCR text was legible enough to identify a clear R or NR mark, that value is reported with normal confidence; where a cell was blank, unreadable, or ambiguous in the OCR output, the field is set to null with a note.

column_definitions.first_aid_hose_reel: R/NR - first-aid hose reel, connected to riser/down-comer, minimum 19 mm diameter hose.
column_definitions.wet_riser: R/NR - wet riser (vertical rising main, min 100 mm nominal diameter, permanently charged with water).
column_definitions.down_comer: R/NR - down-comer (terrace-tank-fed firefighting main, min 100 mm internal diameter).
column_definitions.manually_operated_electronic_fire_alarm_: R/NR - Manually Operated Electronic Fire Alarm system; per Note 1, in specific listed occupancies this column also implies talk-back and public address system provision (2016 folds PA/voice-evacuation into this column via a note rather than giving PA its own dedicated column the way 2026's Table 7A-7J does with 'public_address_and_voice_evacuation_system').
column_definitions.automatic_detection_and_alarm_system: R/NR - automatic fire detection and alarm system (smoke/heat detectors). Per Note 2, not required in car parking areas themselves, but required in ancillary car-parking spaces (electrical rooms, cabins, etc).
column_definitions.underground_static_water_storage_tank_li: Minimum combined capacity (litres) of underground static water storage tank(s) for wet riser/yard hydrant/sprinkler supply.
column_definitions.terrace_tank_over_respective_storage_tan: Minimum terrace tank capacity (litres), sized as noted per band.
column_definitions.pump_capacity_near_underground_tank_lpm: Minimum fire pump capacity (litre/min) at the underground tank, at minimum 3.5 kg/cm2 pressure at the remotest location.
column_definitions.pump_capacity_at_terrace_tank_lpm: Minimum pump capacity (litre/min) at the terrace tank level, minimum pressure 3.5 kg/cm2.

column_count_comparison_to_2026: 2016's Table 7 has 14 columns per row (SL No, Occupancy + 8 installation-type R/NR columns + 4 water-quantity/pump-capacity numeric columns) folded into ONE table. 2026 splits these same concerns across THREE separate table groups: Table 7A-7J (8 R/NR installation columns only, listed in nbcs_2026_partf/table7/_installation_types.json) PLUS a completely separate Table 7K/7M (water quantity and pump sizing, keyed by an abstract HL-x/CL-x 'protection level code' rather than directly by occupancy band). This is a genuine structural/methodology change: 2026 introduced an intermediate abstraction (the HL/CL protection-level code) that decouples 'which installations does this occupancy/band need' from 'how much water and pump capacity does that combination of installations require' - letting the same HL-3 or CL-5 water/pump calculation be reused across many different occupancies' bands. 2016 instead hard-codes a specific litre/lpm figure directly against every individual occupancy band, with no reusable intermediate code.
public_address_voice_evacuation_column_m: 2026's Table 7A-7J has a dedicated 'public_address_and_voice_evacuation_system' R/NR column applied broadly across many occupancy bands. 2016 has NO equivalent standalone column - PA/voice-evacuation/talk-back provision in 2016 is only implied via Note 1 as a rider on the MOEFA requirement for a short, specific list of occupancy bands (starred hotels A-5(d)(1)(iii), certain C-1 hospital bands, and D-1 to D-5 assembly bands, in buildings >=15m, plus car parking areas >300 sqm or multi-level car parks). This suggests 2026 significantly broadened and formalized PA/voice-evacuation as a first-class, independently-tracked requirement across far more occupancies than 2016 required it for.

notes.text: MOEFA System shall also include talk-back system and public address system for the occupancies given in the table for (d)(1)(iii) under A-5, (a)(1)(iv) and (a)(2) under C-1, and (a)(2) under D-1 to D-5, in all buildings 15 m and above in height, except for A-3 and A-4 occupancies where these shall be provided for buildings of height 24 m and above. These shall also be provided in car parking areas more than 300 sqm and in multi-level car parking irrespective of their areas.

Automatic detection and alarm system is not required to be provided in car parking area. Such detection system shall however be required in other areas of car parking such as electrical rooms, cabins and other areas.
Buildings above 15 m in height are not to be permitted for occupancies A-1 and A-2.
Required to be installed in basement, if area of basement exceeds 200 sqm.
Required to be provided if basement area exceeds 200 sqm.
Additional value given in parenthesis shall be added if basement area exceeds 200 sqm.
Required to be provided for buildings with more than two storeys (Ground + One).
Required to be provided for buildings with height above 15 m and above.
Sprinklers shall be fed water from both underground static water storage tank and terrace tank.

Provide required number of sets of pumps each consisting of one electric and one diesel pump (standby) of capacity 2280 litre/min and one electric pump of capacity 180 litre/min (see Fig. 11) (see also Notes 22 and 23).

Provide required number of sets of pumps each consisting of two electric and one diesel pump (standby) of capacity 2280 litre/min and two electric pump of capacity 180 litre/min (see Fig. 12) (see also Notes 22 and 23).

Provide required number of sets of pumps each consisting of two electric and one diesel pump (standby) of capacity 2850 litre/min and two electric pump of capacity 180 litre/min (see Fig. 12) (see also Notes 22 and 23).

Lower levels in high rise buildings 60 m or above in height are likely to experience high pressure and therefore, it is recommended to consider multi-stage, multi-outlet pumps (creating pressure zones) or variable frequency drive pumps or any other equivalent arrangement.

Provide required number of sets of pumps each consisting of one electric and one diesel pump (standby) of capacity 1620 litre/min and one electric pump of capacity 180 litre/min (see Fig. 11) (see also Notes 22 and 23).
Required to be provided for buildings with more than one storey.
Buildings above 30 m in height not to be permitted for Group B, Group C, Group D and Group F occupancies.

The requirements given in this table for Group G Industrial Buildings are for small scale industry units. For other industries the requirements will have to be worked out on the basis of relevant Indian Standards and also in consultation with the local fire authorities.
Buildings above 18 m in height not to be permitted for G-1 and G-2 occupancies.
Buildings above 15 m in height not to be permitted for G-3 occupancies.
Buildings above 15 m in height not to be permitted for Group H and Group J occupancies. However, buildings above 45 m in height shall not be permitted for multi-level car parking (MLCP) occupancy.
Pump capacity shall be based on the covered area of the building.

One set of pumps shall be provided for each 100 hydrants or part thereof, with a maximum of two sets. In case of more than one pump set installation, both pump sets shall be interconnected at their delivery headers.

Alternative to provisions of additional set of pumps, the objective can be met by providing additional diesel pump of the same capacity and doubling the water tank capacity as required for one set of pumps.
As per the requirement of local authority dry riser may be used in hilly areas, industrial areas or as required.
